About.label: About Me
About.heading: Who Am I
About.textReveal: Fresh graduate in Informatics Management from Universitas Riau building things people actually need.
About.p1: I'm Yogi Pranata, a fresh graduate who cares about building software that solves real problems. During my Software Engineer internship at PT Surya Agrolika Reksa (Adimulia Group), I helped build a mobile attendance app with Flutter, which later evolved into my thesis: a web-based attendance system with geotagging, shaped by direct interviews with the company's admin team.
About.p2: I've also worked the front lines of user support as a Customer Happiness intern at Assist.id, a healthcare platform. bridging the gap between users and developers. Currently working with PHP, Laravel, Next.js, and MySQL. Open to Web Developer roles or anything where I get to build and understand who it's for.

points: Handled daily user inquiries, complaints, and suggestions for a healthcare platform (doctors & patients) via chat.
Checked user feature usage and provided correct usage guidelines.
Created and followed up on technical tickets for bug reports until resolution.
Acted as a liaison between user feedback and the technical team for service improvements.
Took the initiative with 4 fellow interns to build an attendance app prototype named AbsenKan.
Developed the application using Flutter and Dart, collaborating with the team's UI designer (Figma).
Interviewed administration executives to understand the operational challenges of attendance recording.
Proposed a web-based attendance system with geotagging as a solution, which now serves as the basis for my final year thesis.
